title: Gorgias Voice and AI Agent vs Dedicated AI Phone Agents for Shopify Subscription Brands
summary: Compare Gorgias Voice and AI Agent with SigmaMind AI for Shopify subscription calls. Review Recharge actions, phone tickets, handoffs, and costs.
body_markdown:
## TL;DR


- [Gorgias Voice](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/guide-to-gorgias-voice-190713) fits brands that want staff to handle calls in Gorgias. It routes calls and creates voice tickets.
- [Gorgias AI Agent](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-explained-497772) automates email, chat, SMS, and social support. Its[Recharge actions](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-actions-manage-recharge-subscriptions-757839) apply to supported channels, but its documentation does not establish autonomous spoken calls.
- Gorgias as the helpdesk plus SigmaMind AI is worth evaluating if you have substantial inbound call volume and want to automate spoken calls. Confirm that SigmaMind AI works with your phone system before choosing that setup.
- Gorgias Voice creates phone tickets natively. Automatic SigmaMind AI call-to-ticket sync is not documented, so you would need to[test that workflow separately](https://sigmamind.ai/blog/voice-ai-shopify-recharge-gorgias-phone-support) .
- Before allowing subscription changes by phone,[define caller-verification, consent, and human-handoff steps](https://sigmamind.ai/blog/shopify-subscription-phone-support-decision-guide) .


## Best-for decision table


For brands with substantial inbound calls, the choice is between staffing those calls in[Gorgias Voice](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/guide-to-gorgias-voice-190713) and evaluating SigmaMind AI for spoken-call automation while Gorgias remains the helpdesk.[Gorgias AI Agent documentation](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-explained-497772) covers text and social channels, not autonomous spoken calls.


Your situation Better starting fit


Call volume is manageable, and agents can answer calls **Gorgias Voice plus AI Agent.** Keep phone support and ticketing in Gorgias while AI Agent handles supported non-phone channels.


Call volume is substantial, and you want to automate spoken calls **Gorgias helpdesk plus SigmaMind AI.** Evaluate voice automation separately from Gorgias’s text-channel automation.


You already use a phone system and CRM you want to keep **Evaluate Gorgias helpdesk plus SigmaMind AI** if you can confirm compatibility with both systems. Test how call information reaches Gorgias; automatic phone-to-ticket sync is not established.


Cancellation mistakes carry high risk **Keep a human in the cancellation path** with either setup until you have tested caller verification, consent, exceptions, and handoff.


The deciding difference is whether staff will answer calls in Gorgias Voice or a separate product will automate spoken calls while Gorgias remains the helpdesk.


## What Gorgias Voice actually does on a phone call


[Gorgias Voice](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/guide-to-gorgias-voice-190713) gives helpdesk agents a way to make and receive calls. Its[setup documentation](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/guide-to-gorgias-voice-190713) describes routing, IVR, and voicemail options, though availability may vary by account. Gorgias creates a voice ticket when a call connects, goes unanswered, or reaches voicemail. Depending on your settings, the ticket can include a recording or transcript, giving an agent a record of what happened on the call.


Agents can transfer an active call to another agent, a queue, or an external number. Gorgias Voice therefore supports staffed phone service with native ticketing and handoffs. Its IVR menus route callers, but the reviewed documentation does not describe an autonomous agent that speaks with them.[Gorgias AI Agent](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-explained-497772) is documented separately for email, chat, SMS, and social channels, not live spoken calls.


## What Gorgias AI Agent automates on supported channels


Gorgias AI Agent can handle subscription requests on its supported messaging channels when you configure the relevant Recharge actions in an AI Agent skill. Its[Recharge documentation](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-actions-manage-recharge-subscriptions-757839) covers subscription detail and status lookups, as well as a list of active subscriptions. Available actions include cancellation, pausing by moving the next charge date, skipping the next shipment, and changing the subscription frequency. With a Recharge connection and the relevant actions configured in an AI Agent skill, Gorgias can handle eligible subscription requests on supported messaging channels.


Cancellation has a specific exception. When a customer has one subscription, the standard action collects a reason, cancels the subscription, and emails confirmation. When the customer has multiple subscriptions, AI Agent hands the ticket to a person instead of choosing which one to cancel. Gorgias also documents a separate action for pausing a selected subscription when the correct record has been identified.


The documented Recharge actions do not establish phone automation.[Gorgias lists AI Agent’s channels](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-explained-497772) as email, chat, SMS, and social messaging, while[Gorgias Voice](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/guide-to-gorgias-voice-190713) documents phone support for human agents. Count a chat cancellation as a messaging-channel resolution, not an automated spoken call.


## SigmaMind AI as a dedicated phone layer beside Gorgias


SigmaMind AI is the separate phone-automation option in this comparison, with Gorgias retained as the helpdesk. SigmaMind AI’s[published Shopify workflow description](https://sigmamind.ai/blog/voice-ai-shopify-recharge-gorgias-phone-support) claims customer, order-status, and fulfillment lookups using a phone or email match; the description alone does not verify those lookups in a buyer’s account. Confirm the connector’s current access and data freshness before relying on those answers during calls. The cited description does not establish Shopify order-changing actions.


Subscription requests need a separate check of Recharge permissions and caller consent. The[published workflow description](https://sigmamind.ai/blog/voice-ai-shopify-recharge-gorgias-phone-support) says SigmaMind AI can retrieve active subscriptions and plan details and modify subscriptions; confirm the available actions and permissions in your account before treating those claims as supported phone workflows. Check Recharge read and write permissions separately. A phone or email match does not prove that the caller owns the subscription. Before allowing a pause, date change, or cancellation by phone, you need to confirm the permitted action and test the caller-verification and confirmation steps. The published material does not establish a default verification threshold for those calls.


For calls that need a person,[SigmaMind AI’s subscription decision guide](https://sigmamind.ai/blog/shopify-subscription-phone-support-decision-guide) describes warm and cold transfers, private whispers, and custom SIP headers. Confirm which options work with your phone system and whether the receiving agent gets the needed context. A transfer or SIP header does not establish that Gorgias received a ticket or call summary.


Neither the[Gorgias marketplace listing](https://www.gorgias.com/apps/sigma-ai) nor the[published Shopify, Recharge, and Gorgias workflow description](https://sigmamind.ai/blog/voice-ai-shopify-recharge-gorgias-phone-support) establishes automatic phone-ticket creation or call-summary sync in Gorgias. If agents need every AI-handled call recorded in Gorgias, that handoff requires separate configuration and testing.


## Caller verification, consent, and cancellation exceptions


If your Gorgias Voice setup matches an incoming number to a Shopify customer profile, that match does not prove the caller owns the account. A human agent can use the[voice ticket and customer context](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/guide-to-gorgias-voice-190713) to investigate a request. Before cancelling a subscription or discussing sensitive billing details, you still need a caller-verification procedure that does not rely on caller ID alone.


Gorgias’s[documented Recharge cancellation action](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-actions-manage-recharge-subscriptions-757839) hands requests involving multiple subscriptions to a person. That exception is useful when planning human review, but the[documented AI Agent channels](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-explained-497772) do not include spoken calls. The cancellation action also does not establish a phone caller-verification method.


For SigmaMind AI phone automation, you need to define and test verification, consent, and action limits before allowing subscription changes. A matching phone number or email may locate an account, but it does not authorize cancellation. The[subscription phone-support decision guide](https://sigmamind.ai/blog/shopify-subscription-phone-support-decision-guide) discusses that distinction. Require confirmation of the selected subscription and the requested change, and route ambiguous requests, charge disputes, and billing-sensitive exceptions to a person. If you record calls, check the consent requirements that apply to your callers. Neither a completed lookup nor a transfer should count as proof that these safeguards ran.


## Setup requirements and integration effort


For staffed calls in Gorgias, confirm the[Voice setup requirements](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/guide-to-gorgias-voice-190713) , including a phone number, applicable routing settings, and access to Voice.[Gorgias Voice creates tickets](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/guide-to-gorgias-voice-190713) for connected, missed, and voicemail calls, so that part of the phone record stays in Gorgias. Separately, you need to configure[AI Agent](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-explained-497772) skills and actions for each supported text or social channel and connect Recharge for its[documented subscription actions](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-actions-manage-recharge-subscriptions-757839) . Those actions are not documented for live spoken calls.


Adding SigmaMind AI means setting up a separate phone layer while keeping Gorgias as your helpdesk. You need scoped Shopify and Recharge access for the intended lookups or approved changes, plus a phone number or telephony connection. Confirm which human-transfer options SigmaMind AI supports with your phone system, then test whether the receiving agent gets the needed context. Do not assume whispers or SIP headers provide that context in your setup. Before allowing subscription changes, test caller verification, consent, and cancellation exceptions. The published[Shopify, Recharge, and Gorgias workflow guide](https://sigmamind.ai/blog/voice-ai-shopify-recharge-gorgias-phone-support) does not establish automatic call-summary or ticket write-back to Gorgias. If your agents need those records in Gorgias, determine whether a supported integration exists. If no supported integration meets that requirement, estimate the cost of custom work and test the resulting call records against representative calls.


## Like-for-like cost checklist


Compare the cost of handling the same call mix under both setups. Include the[current Gorgias Helpdesk charges](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/how-youre-billed-for-using-gorgias-199385) on both sides if you keep Gorgias in either setup. Check how each call workflow affects billable tickets rather than assuming the same ticket count.


- **Gorgias Voice plus AI Agent.** Confirm current[Gorgias Voice pricing and billing terms](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/how-youre-billed-for-using-gorgias-199385) , including any applicable voice-ticket allowance and overages. Add[Helpdesk ticket charges and AI Agent resolution fees](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/how-youre-billed-for-using-gorgias-199385) where applicable. AI Agent fees cover automated resolutions on its supported channels, not autonomous phone calls. Ask Gorgias whether a call followed by a billable helpdesk message creates charges in both categories.
- **Gorgias plus SigmaMind AI.** Check[current SigmaMind AI pricing](https://sigmamind.ai/pricing) for voice minutes and ask which speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language-model, telephony, and phone-number charges are included or billed separately. If human agents still handle some calls through Gorgias Voice, include those Voice charges too.
- **Work both setups require.** Include the cost of human escalations and ongoing maintenance. For the SigmaMind AI path, estimate the work needed to verify authorized Shopify and Recharge access, connect the phone system, and test transfers. Include Gorgias ticket write-back costs if a supported automatic sync is unavailable and your agents need those records. Do not assume phone calls automatically create Gorgias tickets.


Voice tickets and voice minutes measure different things. Ask both vendors for current quotes based on your monthly calls, average call length, escalation rate, and expected ticket volume. Compare total costs for the same call mix and count only the subscription requests each setup can resolve under the permissions and safeguards you have verified.

- Review data access and handoffs in the[Shopify, Recharge, and Gorgias integration guide](https://sigmamind.ai/blog/voice-ai-shopify-recharge-gorgias-phone-support) .
- Assess verification and cancellation exceptions in the[subscription phone-support decision guide](https://sigmamind.ai/blog/shopify-subscription-phone-support-decision-guide) .


## FAQs


**Does Gorgias AI Agent answer phone calls?** The[AI Agent documentation](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-explained-497772) lists email, chat, SMS, and social channels. It does not document autonomous handling of spoken calls. Gorgias offers human phone support through Voice.


**Does SigmaMind AI automatically create Gorgias tickets from calls?** The cited materials do not establish automatic call-to-ticket sync. Confirm whether a supported integration exists; if it does not, assess custom integration and testing. By contrast,[Gorgias Voice creates its own voice tickets](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/guide-to-gorgias-voice-190713) when calls connect, are missed, or reach voicemail.


**Can Gorgias AI Agent cancel a subscription over chat?** Gorgias[documents a Recharge cancellation action](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/ai-agent-actions-manage-recharge-subscriptions-757839) for supported channels when the relevant AI Agent skill and Recharge connection are configured. When a customer has multiple subscriptions, the standard action hands the ticket to a person rather than choosing one to cancel. The documentation does not establish that the action works on spoken calls.


**Is Gorgias Voice itself an AI phone agent?** No.[Gorgias Voice](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/handle-tickets-in-gorgias-voice-296977) supports human-staffed calls and can include transcripts in voice tickets. Optional transcription does not mean an AI agent answers the call.


## Conclusion


Choose based on which channel you need to automate. If your agents can handle calls and you want phone records in Gorgias, Gorgias Voice may fit alongside AI Agent’s text-channel automation. If substantial call volume makes phone automation the priority, evaluate SigmaMind AI as a separate phone layer while keeping Gorgias as your helpdesk.


Before committing, test representative order-status and cancellation calls in the setup you are considering. Check caller verification, consent, exceptions, transfer context, and whether the resulting call record reaches Gorgias.
